action.description: The single action to take this turn.

query.description: For action=search: the web search query. Null otherwise.

url.description: For action=fetch: a URL seen in a prior search result to retrieve. Null otherwise.

answer.description: For action=final: the finding, in the required output format. Null otherwise.

citations.description: For action=final: the sources relied on. Null otherwise.
